Included in every plan

  • Live map of every warehouse, shop and shipment in motion, with ETAs

  • Live two-way stock with WooCommerce
  • Roles and permissions per location, plus a full activity log
  • English and Arabic, on desktop and mobile

The only thing you pay for

What counts as a location?

A location is a warehouse, a branch or a shop. That is the only thing that sets your price.

A warehouse= 1 location
A shop= 1 location
A branch= 1 location
Never counted or limited
  • Items (SKUs)
  • Stock moves
  • Telegram bot users

Works with your setup

Already using Odoo, Zoho or WooCommerce?

Stacko works on top of your system for the same price, and your data keeps syncing. Use it as your full inventory app or next to the system you have: the plan costs the same either way.

  • Odoo
  • ERPNext
  • Zoho Inventory
  • WooCommerce
  • Shopify
  • Excel / Google Sheets

Setup

Connecting a shop (WooCommerce, Shopify) or a spreadsheet is self-serve and free.

A guided setup for Odoo, ERPNext or Zoho, or a custom connector, is quoted separately.

Pricing questions

Do you charge per user or per item?

No. You pay per location only.

What happens when I reach my limit?

The app tells you, and you can add locations or upgrade.

Can I change plan later?

Yes, any time. Just contact us.

Do Telegram users count?

No. Staff who only use the Telegram bot are free.

What if AI credits run out?

Top up, upgrade, or use your own Claude key.

Is setup included?

Self-serve connections are free. Guided setup is quoted.

Is there a free trial?

Yes, 14 days on every plan.
